task: A practice player has a safe closing route and an optional extra development. Compare spending and saving against an independently chosen rival response.
Use an invented resource ledger to compare a threat answered cheaply with one requiring two responses. Record the rival's remaining development options and the ignore branch.
Compare an exposed early contest with a protected development line. After the first action fails, re-evaluate rather than automatically rescuing it.

After a practice game, freeze information available at the choice and compare two alternative lines with different hypothetical opposing hands. Separate probability assumptions from legal possibilities.
